## Privacy And Release Hygiene

- [ ] No API keys, cookies, `.env` files, local `~/.pockedio/` data, diary/calendar content, or generated audio are committed.
- [ ] UI or terminal changes include a screenshot or terminal transcript when useful.
- [ ] New public behavior is documented in `README.md` or `docs/`.
